meta.name: Combat visuals manifest
meta.purpose: Maps combat context (and, from ticket 09, enemy/ally template key) to the art asset that renders it, so the combat stage (scenes/components/combat_stage.gd, driven by scenes/screens/combat_rounds.gd) never hardcodes a path. See docs/combat-animation-vision.md §2.1/§6 and docs/ART-BIBLE.md.
meta.backdropRule: One entry per Combat.CANONICAL_CONTEXTS context (systems/combat.gd). 'image' is a res:// path to a 390x360 backdrop plate, or "" when no plate has been produced yet -- the stage then fills with the flat data/palette.json colour named by 'fallbackColor' instead.
meta.locationBackdropRule: 'locationBackdrops' maps a combat.locationKey (a data/districts.json id, or 'home') to { image } and is checked before 'backdrops': location plate -> context plate -> fallbackColor (docs/combat-animation-vision.md §2.1). A missing key or an unloadable image falls through to the context tier.
meta.templateRule: Ticket 09 (amended by a ticket-10 follow-up): 'templates' keys other than 'default' are the seven cast subjects (docs/combat-animation-vision.md §3) resolved by CombatStage.enemy_template_key()/display-entry building -- the player's state.player.model key (a discovered territorial variant such as 'territorial3' -- not written here: GameData.combat_templates() builds one entry per assets/combat/territorial<N>/ folder from 'territorialVariant', and a hand-written entry of the same key would win), the recruited-ally contactId (e.g. 'archie'), the data/enemies.json raidGuards key (veinGuard/orichalchumDealer; a Territorial Scrapper instead draws the territorial variant stored in its combat entry's 'variant'), 'homeRaidRaider' (GameData.ENEMY_HOME_RAID_RAIDER), and 'mugger' (any enemy with isMugging true, however many concurrent instances -- one sheet, reused). Each subject's 'idle' entry is {image, frameCount, fps}; an empty 'image' means no dedicated art has been produced yet -- CombatStage.StageSlot falls back to 'default's own idle entry (the same Gangsters_2-sourced stand-in attack/hit/ko already share) rather than the ticket-01 placeholder box, per-subject, not an error. The ticket-01 box is still there as a defensive fallback (a broken/missing 'default' entry), just not expected to trigger in normal play any more.
meta.actionRule: Ticket 10, docs/combat-animation-vision.md §4: 'attack' (3 keyposes: wind-up/strike/recover, played with a transform lunge-and-return), 'hit' (1 pose, played with a transform recoil), and 'ko' (2 poses, played with a transform fall+fade) exist per-subject exactly like 'idle' -- CombatStage loads whichever of a sheet's frames the doctrine calls for (down-sampling evenly if a sheet carries more, e.g. templates.default's own multi-frame stand-in strips) and falls back to templates.default's shared stand-in when a subject's own entry is empty, same two-level fallback 'idle' now uses too (see 'templateRule' above). 'throw' (2 poses: wind-up, release with a small forward push) plays when a subject uses an item (CombatRoundsScreen.beat_cues() emits a 'throw' cue for item beats and for item moves, via _move_pose_cues()) -- per-subject, no default fallback, so a subject without throw art just doesn't animate. attack/hit/ko 'fps' values here (5.0/5.0/3.0) are deliberately much lower than idle's -- they pace a short keypose sequence (3/2/2 steps after down-sampling), not a dense flipbook, and were tuned so the total on-screen time per one-shot is close to what the pre-ticket-10 flipbook version showed (a human-flagged regression: the doctrine's own frameCount at the OLD higher fps made each one-shot roughly half as long as before, worsening how long a subject without idle art is actually visible during its own turn).
meta.effectRule: Ticket 11, docs/combat-animation-vision.md §5: one entry per consumable that has a signature *sheet* effect (as opposed to a pure transform -- enhancementPowder's afterimage, wormhole's fold-and-vanish, and rewind/failsafe's beat-queue-in-reverse are all transform-only, no manifest entry, per the ticket's own 'no new art' list). Each entry is {image, frameCount, fps} at 96x96 native (docs/ART-BIBLE.md §6.1), except blackHole at 160x160 ('the one expensive effect'). 'image' empty means no asset has been produced yet -- CombatStage.play_effect() degrades the same way every other manifest lookup in this file does: no frames, no visual, the beat still plays (juice/shader/transform pieces that don't depend on a sheet -- timePearl's enemy-desaturate + slowed idle tweens, shield's crack-on-absorb overlay, blast's hit-flash/shake -- run regardless). No per-subject keying (unlike templates.*) -- an effect sheet is the same regardless of who triggered it or who it lands on, played once per 'effect' cue: CombatRoundsScreen.beat_cues() maps an item beat kind to its sheet key (_ITEM_EFFECTS -- heal/healSelf -> healingBurst, shieldOther -> shield), on the beat's target (a self 'shield': its actor), or once per 'affected' combatant for timePearl/blackHole.

stage._note: spriteScale: multiplier on every combat stage slot's height (player, allies, enemies) over the base zone ratios in scenes/components/combat_stage.gd.

reserve._note: Waiting fighters (combat.enemyQueue/allyQueue): up to maxVisible small distant sprites per side in queue order, then +N. heightRatio/bottomRatio are fractions of the staging zone (height, and the sprites' bottom edge below the zone top); stepXOfWidth spaces them along the outer edge; entryDuration is the slide into the active place.

cardFrames._note: Street-sign nine-slice frames for turn-order cards (scenes/components/turn_order_strip.gd), keyed by damage tier. margin: nine-slice margin in px on all four sides; see assets/combat/combat-cards/README.md.

intro._note: Fight-opening intro (CombatStage.play_intro, CombatRoundsScreen._play_intro). Seconds unless noted. stageUp: backdrop fade + zoom from zoomFrom to 1.0. enter: each fighter's slide; stagger: delay between consecutive fighters (front slot first, sides alternating). offscreenMarginPx: how far past the stage edge a fighter starts. squash*: landing squash (scale x/y, hold). dust*: puff size/rise in px, fade seconds. reserveFade: reserves + overflow badge fade-in. hudReveal: transcript fade + dock rise (dockRisePx). deal*: turn-order strip deal-in (dealFly: per-card flight, dealStagger: gap between cards, dealDeckOffsetPx: deck point relative to the strip's top-centre, dealSfx: optional flick sound, skipped if the file is absent). quickScale multiplies every duration under Quick pacing.

pacing._note: turnPause: seconds held between two combatants' turns during beat playback and Rewind, per CombatPacing mode (scenes/components/combat_director.gd). rewindSpeed: how many times faster a Rewind's reverse playback runs than forward pacing.

rewindEffect._note: VHS look over the stage while a Rewind's reverse plays (shaders/vhs_rewind.gdshader, CombatStage.set_rewind_effect). Px values are stage pixels; tint is [r, g, b, mix].
rewindEffect.label: ◀◀ REW

freezeFx._note: VCR-pause look on a Time-Pearl-frozen sprite (shaders/vcr_pause.gdshader, CombatStage.StageSlot.set_frozen_visual). shiverPx/shiverHz: horizontal field jitter; flickerEvery: every Nth field shows the previous frame; band*: tracking band (period seconds feet->head, height as UV fraction, shear in sprite px). tapeStopSeconds/tapeStopSmear: downward drag easing out when the freeze lands (smear as UV fraction); playSnapSeconds/playSnapJoltPx: band sweep + sideways jolt when it ends. Seconds halve under quick pacing.

runOffFx._note: Run-off exit for a successful Leg it / Panic bolt (CombatStage.StageSlot.play_run_off): fighter turns away, crouchSeconds crouch (crouchPx down), slides off the nearest stage edge in runSeconds (ease-in) leaving afterimageCount trail ghosts (fade afterimageFadeSeconds) and a dust kick (dustSizePx, rising dustRisePx over dustFadeSeconds). Rewind plays play_run_in, the same run reversed. Seconds halve under quick pacing; reduced motion drops dust and afterimages.

saveFx._note: Last-ditch saves (StageSlot.set_silhouette / pop_flag / glow, CombatStage.play_local_rewind). freezeSeconds: hit-stop after the killing hit; silhouetteSeconds: white-out hold; localRewindSeconds: VHS patch over the player (vignetteInner: UV radius where its fade starts, padPx: grown past the slot); flag*: the spent-unit flag pops flagRisePx then falls flagFallPx and fades; staggerSeconds: an ally's silhouette beat; glow*: a guard-kit rewind's cyan glow on the ally. Seconds halve under quick pacing; reduced motion drops the local VHS, keeps silhouette and flag.

wormholeFx._note: Wormhole escape (CombatStage.play_lens_tear, combat_rounds screen). tearSeconds: the cyan-orange lens tear at the vanish point (a single frame); tearWidthPx/tearGapPx: its two bands; holdSeconds: the empty slot held before the outcome card. Seconds halve under quick pacing; reduced motion drops the tear.

statusIcons._note: Stage status icons above a sprite (scenes/components/status_icon_row.gd). Per id: chip ('buff' rounded light rim, 'debuff' notched dark rim), colour (ore family; white where no item causes it), glyph (9 rows of 9, '#' lit; or 'spinner' for the animated buffering wheel), image (res:// png drawn 9x9 instead of the glyph when set). Tuning: popSeconds/flashSeconds/tickSeconds/expireSeconds, maxShown, spinnerHz.

effects._note: Per effect: image/frameCount/fps (the sheet), colour [r,g,b] (stand-in ring + travel spark; ore family, proposal §1), landColour (optional: the ring's colour when it differs from the spark's), travelSeconds (spark flight before the land, 0 = none), landSeconds (stand-in ring life when image is empty), shakeScale (stage shake at land, x the hit's shake; 0 = none), hitStopSeconds (stage freeze at land, 0 = none). Seconds halve under quick pacing.

itemFx._note: Shared item-effect pieces (CombatStage / StageSlot). spark*: travel projectile (sizePx square, trailCount ghosts spaced trailGapSeconds, arcPx peak lift). ring*: stand-in land ring, radii as fractions of the slot's width. guardFlickerSeconds: a target's guard marker blinks off this long when a Blast ignores it. disarm: generic weapon shape (sizePx) that spins degrees and rises risePx over seconds. legItStreak: orange streaks behind a boosted Leg it (count lines, lengthPx long, over seconds). Seconds halve under quick pacing; reduced motion drops shake, hit-stop, trails and streaks.

powderFx._note: Enhancement Powder (StageSlot.play_powder_launch / set_powder_linger). puff*: green-gold specks at headFraction of the slot height (count at launch, exitCount at exit; sizePx square, rise px over seconds, spread px apart, colours cycle). idleSpeed: idle fps multiplier while it holds; exitSeconds: the ease back. trail*: ghosts left behind each lunge/throw (count, alpha, gapSeconds apart, fadeSeconds). Seconds halve under quick pacing; reduced motion drops puffs and trails and sets the idle speed outright.

removalFx._note: How a fighter loses actions (CombatStage / StageSlot). stun: head-bob on lost-action fighters (shaders/stun_bob.gdshader; bobSeconds loop, shearPx top sway). timePearlLeadSeconds: the landing ripple plays this long before the tape-stop. blackHole: bead (beadSizePx, beadColour rim) lifts liftSeconds to the enemy band's centre and hangs hangSeconds; the warp runs warpSeconds (backdrop pinchPct pull, enemies lean leanDegrees and stretch stretchPct, numbers fly numberFlySeconds from the centre), then a popSeconds outward ring and shake (shakeScale). Seconds halve under quick pacing; reduced motion drops pinch, lean and shake.

healFx._note: Healing Burst (StageSlot.play_heal_burst / play_heal_fizzle, CombatStage.spawn_damage_number). mote*: specks rising from the feet (count, sizePx square, risePx over riseSeconds, spreadPx apart, colours cycle gold/cyan). rim*: one sine pulse of a tinted sprite copy (rimAlpha peak over rimSeconds). numberColour: the green +N. fizzle*: the motes rise riseFraction of the way, then fall fallPx and scatter scatterPx sideways in greyColour over fizzleSeconds. Seconds halve under quick pacing; reduced motion drops the rim pulse and the fizzle scatter (motes and number stay).

panFx._note: Panic and Pan's Rapture (StageSlot.set_panic_linger / play_cower, set_rapture_linger / play_rapture_bloom / play_enraptured). Panic linger: jitterPx square-wave offset at jitterHz, tint greyed by desaturate (0..1 toward grey); cower: sprite squashes squashPct down for cowerSeconds, shuddering shudderPct wide at shudderHz. Rapture linger: idle at idleSpeed, sways swayDegrees about the feet every swaySeconds, tinted tint at tintMix; bloom: tinted sprite copy pulses bloomAlpha over bloomSeconds; enraptured: sway holds at peak lean holdSeconds while pink motes (mote*) rise. Seconds halve under quick pacing; reduced motion drops jitter, shudder, sway, bloom and motes (tint and icons stay).

angerFx._note: Panger and Pandemonium (StageSlot.set_anger_state / play_anger_land, CombatStage.play_fury_line). land: the sprite flashes landColour at landAlpha twice (landFlashSeconds each, landGapSeconds apart). Phase: a rim (a tinted sprite copy) in hotRim pulsing between pulseLowFraction and 1 of rimAlpha every pulseSeconds, scale +scalePct%; coldRim steady, scale -scalePct% and the sprite slumps slumpPx. flip: a squash of flipSquashPct for flipSeconds as the rim colour swaps. calm: the rim fades and scale eases home over calmSeconds. steam (fury only): wisps of wispSizePx rise risePx over riseSeconds every steamIntervalSeconds from headFraction of the slot height. furyLine: a lineThicknessPx line in lineColour for lineSeconds from attacker to its ally target. Seconds halve under quick pacing; reduced motion drops the land flash, pulse, scale, slump, squash and steam (rim colour stays).

ladyFx._note: Be a Lady (StageSlot.play_lady_sweep / play_lady_glint, CombatStage.spawn_damage_number). sweep*: the brass band rising up the sprite at launch. glint*: the one-frame clover-green cross at a landed Strike's impact (sizePx; critScale bigger on a crit, which adds critHitStopSeconds of hit-stop). numberColour: the brass damage number. Seconds halve under quick pacing; reduced motion drops the sweep and glints, keeps the brass number.

territorialVariant._note: Shared pose spec for every discovered assets/combat/territorial<N>/ folder (GameData.TERRITORIAL_VARIANTS). Each file stem resolves to territorial<N>/territorial<N>_<stem>.png; a pose, or one attack variant, loads only when all its files exist. Attack 'variants' are alternative swings, one picked at random per attack: a 1-pose jab, or guard wind-up then cross. ko reuses the hurt pose under the ko fall+fade transform.

default._note: TEMPORARY build-test stand-in (ticket 10) -- untouched asset-pack frames (assets/combat/dummy), not final art. Only attack/hit/ko still read this entry; idle no longer does (ticket 09 moved idle to the per-subject keys below).

archie._note: Single-pose stills, not sheets (frameCount 1 each) -- ko art not produced yet, fall back per templateRule/effectRule above.

james._note: Separate single-pose files ('images', one frame each) -- attack plays attack_1 wind-up then attack_2 strike; 'cast' is the Dial-cast pose (BEAT_ALLY_CAST). james_idle2.png is 530x470 vs the 1347x1168 set, so idle uses james_idle.png only.

orichalchumDealer._note: Asset-pack sourced stand-in (assets/Gangsters_3), untouched, same convention as templates.default -- see that entry's own _note. Not final art.
